differential.name: Diabetic nephropathy
differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with microalbuminuria and eGFR ~45 mL/min points to diabetic kidney disease as the primary cause of CKD.

differential.name: Hypertensive chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Coexisting metabolic syndrome and likely hypertension can produce nephrosclerosis contributing to the reduced GFR.

differential.name: Atherosclerotic coronary artery disease
differential.rationale: Dyslipidemia, diabetes, obesity, and CKD markedly raise risk for ischemic heart disease, often silent in older adults.

differential.name: Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease / NASH
differential.rationale: Metabolic syndrome, elevated triglycerides, and obesity make NAFLD a common comorbidity in this patient.

differential.name: Lumbar degenerative disc disease (osteoarthritis of spine)
differential.rationale: Chronic low back pain in a 67‑year‑old obese patient is most often due to degenerative changes of the lumbar spine.
